desk.name: Arthur's Desk
desk.description: Arthur Blackwood's personal mahogany writing desk. A green desk lamp casts a dim light.

glass.name: Spilled Red Wine Glass
glass.description: A crystal wine glass lies spilled. Red wine has pooled on the desk blotter.

drawer.name: Mahogany Drawer
drawer.description: A locked side drawer on the desk. Needs a key.

phone.name: Arthur's Smartphone
phone.description: An iPhone with a cracked screen. On the home screen is an unread text message: 'We know what you did. The thread is pulling.'

fireplace.name: Stone Fireplace
fireplace.description: A massive carved stone fireplace. Embers are cold.

ash.name: Burnt Paper Scrap
ash.description: A scrap of partially charred ledger page recovered from the ashes. It reads: 'Blackwood Holdings ... Transferred to VH ... $1,200,000'.

cabinet.name: Display Cabinet
cabinet.description: A glass display cabinet containing decorative antiques.

cabinet_lock.name: Torn Ledger Page
cabinet_lock.description: A financial log showing suspicious offshore wire transactions to bank routing coordinates linked to VH.

floor.name: Study Floor
floor.description: The Persian rug beneath Arthur's desk.

footprint.name: Muddy Shoeprint
footprint.description: A faint shoeprint left in mud on the wooden floor near the window, matching sizing associated with Victor Hayes.

counter.name: Kitchen Counter
counter.description: A stainless steel kitchen counter covered with prep items.

coffee_cup.name: Stained Coffee Cup
coffee_cup.description: A porcelain coffee cup with faint lipstick marks matching Olivia's profile.

pantry.name: Pantry Shelves
pantry.description: Shelves stocked with canned goods and spices.

pantry_key.name: Brass Cabinet Key
pantry_key.description: A heavy brass key stored inside a container labeled 'Flour'. Unlocks the desk drawer in Arthur's study.

flowerbed.name: Flowerbed near Study Window
flowerbed.description: A flowerbed outside the study window, heavily trampled.

footprints.name: Trampled Mud Footprints
footprints.description: Deep impressions of boots in the mud near the window ledges. Matches Victor's shoes.

computer.name: Security Computer
computer.description: The main security monitoring terminal. Requires a login password.

gate_logs.name: Gate Entry Log
gate_logs.description: Security logs showing Victor Hayes's vehicle scanned entering the estate gate at 10:45 PM and departing at 11:35 PM.

hall_logs.name: Corridor Feed logs
hall_logs.description: Camera logs showing a hooded figure walking down the study corridor at 11:10 PM.

whiteboard.name: Security Noticeboard
whiteboard.description: A cork board with staff duties and schedules.

password_note.name: Noticeboard Note
password_note.description: A sticky note pinned to the board reads: 'System maintenance login: 1003'.

easel.name: Work Easel
easel.description: A tall wooden easel showing a half-finished abstract canvas.

canvas.name: Sophia's Painting
canvas.description: An oil painting depicting a bleeding figure on a desk. Creepily resembles Arthur's final pose.
